title: xDrip without Play Services
symptom: On an Android phone without Google Play Services used as a follower, sending measurements from the master to InfluxDB works, but no readings are received on the follower. The user asks if it should download from InfluxDB or if it only works via Play Services.
fix: Use a Nightscout site to upload data, then on the follower phone install the Nightscout client and set xDrip to receive data from it. Alternatively, xDrip now works with microG implementation.
evidence_quote: Create a nightscout site and upload data there. Than on follower phone install nightscout client and set xdrip to receive data from it. This should allow getting bg data to work.
